notes.decision: Translated 'salvation' (verbal-noun of ⲛⲁⲍⲙⲉϩ 'save/rescue', already in vocabulary). The ⲟⲓⲛ- prefix nominalizes the verbal stem to give an action-noun; this is the same structure as ⲧⲟⲓⲛⲃⲱⲗ 'the dissolution.' The series of 'salvations' (second, fourth, fifth) structures this kephalaion as an enumeration of cosmic redemptive acts.
Greek ζώνη 'girdle, zone' — the cosmological belt/zodiacal zone, already in accumulated vocabulary. Jesus the Radiance reveals himself in this Zone before the firmaments.

Reading uncertain across the line break. The word begins ⲡⲁⲣⲭⲓⲁⲕ- (with [ⲡⲁⲣⲭⲓⲁ] restored, ⲕ visible) and resumes ⲭⲏ on line 21. Possibilities include ⲁⲣⲭⲓⲉⲣⲁⲣⲭⲏ 'archhierarchy', ⲁⲣⲭⲓⲁ + ⲕⲁⲑⲟⲗⲓⲕⲏ 'catholic principle/origin', or some other Greek-derived ecclesiastical compound. Translated tentatively as 'arch-...-y' with the gap externalized. Jesus's establishment of this 'principle of all the churches' fits the Manichaean role of Jesus as founder of the apostolic line.
'The molding of the flesh' — variant of ⲡⲡⲗⲁⲥⲙⲁ ⲛ̄ⲧⲙⲛ̄ⲧⲣⲱⲙⲉ 'the molding of humanity' (in vocabulary). The flesh-form fashioned by the archons, into which Jesus descended.

ⲧⲟⲩⲱ preserved as 'raise' per mandatory terminology. ⲍⲱϥ = reflexive intensifier 'himself'; ⲁⲛ = 'again, also.' The construction takes its object across the line break ('he himself raised once again {31} of the immeasurable light'). The vertical-soteriological motion is preserved.
The Call and the Hearing — standard Manichaean Call/Answer pair, here applied at the level of the cosmic elements (ⲛ̄ⲥⲧⲟⲭⲉⲓⲱⲛ).
ⲙⲟⲩⲛⲕ 'mold, fashion, form.' Used here of Jesus 'forming' Jesus the Youth (ⲓⲏⲥ̄ ⲡⲗⲓⲗⲟⲩ) — the Third Power's emanation. Translated 'form' to preserve the molding-fashioning semantics.

'The fifth release-forth.' ⲧⲙⲁⲍⲧ̄ⲉ = feminine ordinal 'fifth.' ⲛ̄ⲟⲓⲛⲡ̄ⲃⲁⲗ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ — verbal noun on ⲃⲱⲗ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'release.' The ⲡ̄ may be article ('the loosing'); compare ⲧⲟⲓⲛⲃⲱⲗ in vocabulary. Paired in line 29 with ⲧⲟⲓⲛⲛⲟⲩⲍⲙⲉ 'salvation' as a doublet. The pair release-forth + salvation matches the standard ⲃⲱⲗ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ / ⲛⲁⲍⲙⲉϩ pairing.

'The Great Counsel' — already in accumulated vocabulary as a divine title (fourth of the cosmic faces). Here identified with the Call/Hearing pair, fitting the Manichaean equation Great Counsel = Living Spirit (the divinity of the Call).

The intervening ⲡⲧⲉ between ⲡⲧⲱⲍⲙⲉ and ⲙⲛ̄ ⲡⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ is grammatically odd; it may be a relative-genitive linker, hence 'the Call together with the Hearing.' Could also be scribal echo of the preceding ⲉ-ⲧⲉ 'which-is.' The sense is clear: the Great Counsel = the Call + the Hearing.
